messages:
deploy-bot: automated rollback triggered for rollout v2.9.1 -> reason: p95 latency breach (>=250ms over 5m). initiating rollback to v2.9.0 and pinning traffic. :warning:
jen: whoa — hold the full rollback. we just got an escalation from ACME (large EU customer) saying requests are 500ing but only for specific model variant, they asked us to keep canary live while we investigate.
marco: agree with jen — auto rollback will disrupt their workflow. can we suppress auto-rollback and pin the region to v2.9.0 while leaving canary traffic at 5% for debugging?
ops-oncall: what does deploy-bot have queued? any in-flight cutovers we need to stop?
deploy-bot: current rollback job started at 1743500000 and is 30% complete. queued operations: drain nodes in eu-west-1 pool, reassign traffic. manual override flag accepted by user jen; suppressing remaining rollback steps.
sam: thanks. plan: 1) cancel remaining drain, 2) pin eu-west traffic to v2.9.0 for customer-facing routes, 3) keep 5% canary on v2.9.1 for full trace capture, 4) roll forward auto-rollback enabled only after 2h if no regression found. ok?
marco: sounds good. add KV cache snapshot and a trace sampling increase for the canary. we need full request logs + model ids for the 500s.
jen: @katie please draft a 1-line customer note: "we're investigating intermittent 500s for a subset of requests, your traffic will remain routed with minimal disruption; we will follow up by EOD"
katie: on it. will send to ACME PM and include the trace id placeholder.
ops-oncall: commands executed: `deploybot cancel-job 1743500000` -> success, `deploybot pin-version --region eu-west-1 --version v2.9.0 --reason "customer requested suppress auto-rollback"` -> success.
deploy-bot: manual pin recorded, audit id 88f3. suppression window set for 2 hours. auto-rollback re-enable scheduled at 1743507200 unless manually extended. :lock:
sam: logging note: create internal incident ticket (INC-2024-1743) with links to traces and canary samples. assign to eng-runtime and eng-ml.
marco: I'll grab traces and start a targeted repro run against the variant. if we confirm model regression, plan is to revert model binary only and re-run quick canary.
jen: thanks team — good job catching this early. katie will send the customer note, sam will open incident, marco will do traces. keep thread updated with any new findings. :thumbsup:
katie: sent to ACME PM, subject "Investigating intermittent errors — keeping your traffic stable". included contact details and ETA EOD.
marco: initial traces show elevated tail latency on model shard 3, correlation with KV misses. investigating quantization edge-case.
ops-oncall: marking this thread as actioned; I'll watch the suppression window and hand back to deploy automation if we clear in 2h.
jen: closing loop — if we need to do a full rollback later, we'll run the standard rollback checklist and notify sales/support before flipping traffic. for now we keep manual pin in place.
